name: gelombang-aspal
description: 60-second vertical explainer short rendered with three.js in headless Chrome, sharded across GitHub Actions runners. No AI video model.

scripts.encode: ffmpeg -y -v error -framerate 24 -i out/frames/f_%05d.jpg -i audio.wav -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/video.mp4
